styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating warm section panels: cream page #FFF7EC, apricot orange rounded panels #F0A24F, clean white #FFFFFF infographic sections, dark charcoal #232323 studio backdrop only inside rounded photo cards; all content blocks use large rounded corners

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm pet-outdoor ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream page background #FFF7EC, apricot orange section panels #F0A24F, pure white rounded cards #FFFFFF, deep orange accent #DE5F1E, with deep charcoal #2D2D2D reserved for headline text; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines, all in-image Chinese wrapped in 「」, small deep-orange pill kickers above headlines and thin vertical divider lines at section edges; rounded-corner white info cards with orange circle thin-line icons; soft warm diffused daylight with gentle shadows, flat even light on infographic screens; the pet always shown wearing the product correctly and comfortably or the product laid flat, never floating; clean breathing margins around every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 12 片 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。已剥离：源品牌字样（「九零」）、错误拼写英文 kicker（Tractuion rope 等）、走失找回率 0.1% 统计数字、会员二维码与门店徽章；对比图「别家反光绳」改为通用「普通反光绳」，规格数字改为 callout 占位由使用者填真实数据。关键假设：第 4、10 片中部分照片区未加载（橙/白圆角色块），对应文案取自相邻标注推断；材质鹿皮绒、四色配色（蓝/粉/白/金）依规格表与变体标注判定。实测主品为狗狗背心式牵引绳（反光防挣脱），与源文件夹「宠物用品 (19)」品类一致；库内已有出行类模版为胶囊投食猫包，本品以 leaf「狗狗背心式牵引绳」区分，未覆盖任何既有文件。
